_note: All thresholds are ASSUMPTIONS for the hackathon. Teachers can change them in settings.

next_courses_after._ASSUMPTION: Confirm eligibility with a teacher before the demo.

tag_vocabulary_note: Suggestions only. A teacher can type any other skill; it is saved on the participant's notes as a tag.

outreach._note: Team decision 2026-11-14: gap reduced from 14 to 3 days; quiet hours and the approval step removed for the hackathon.

banned_phrases_note: Match whole words and phrases, case-insensitive (so 'fee' does not match 'feel' and 'deal' does not match 'ideal'). Treat straight and curly apostrophes as the same.

notifications._ASSUMPTION: Automatic notifications. Wording follows CLAUDE.md rule 2: no mention of missed days, gaps or price. Triggers and limits are assumptions to confirm with a teacher.
notifications._demo_teacher_sent_only_NOTE: Team decision 2026-11-15, for the two-device demo: banners appear only for what the teacher sends (invitation, reply, new event nearby, seva thank-you) and for the participant's own first practice and streak milestones. Exception added 2026-11-15: the practice note (3 days with no practice) stays on, so Carlos (P14) opens with one. The welcome and the other time-based notifications stay in the spec and come back when this is false.

examples.welcome: Welcome, {first_name}. We're so glad you're here. Your course group and {teacher} are close by whenever you have a question. 🙏
examples.first_practice: {first_name}, your first practice is logged. A lovely way to begin. 🌿
examples.practice_note: Hi {first_name}, a few quiet minutes are here for you whenever you'd like. 🌿
examples.streak_milestone: {n} days in a row, {first_name}. That's a real habit taking root. 🎉
examples.event_note: {first_name}, there's a {event} this {weekday}, {minutes} min from you. You'd be very welcome.
examples.course_group_going: {name} and {n} others from your course are going to {event}. Come along if you'd like, {first_name}.
examples.new_event_nearby: {first_name}, {event} is happening this {weekday} near you. Would you like a reminder?
examples.event_reminder: {first_name}, tomorrow is {event}, {time} in {place}. Looking forward to seeing you.
examples.seva_thank_you: Thank you for your seva today, {first_name}. You helped make it happen. 💛
examples.course_anniversary: {first_name}, today marks {n} month(s) since your course. Look how far you've come: {practice_days} practice days. 🙏

guided_practice._NOTE: Guided meditation by Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar. The link was chosen by the team on 2026-11-14. The app plays it from YouTube and does not copy the audio. Title and length are not filled in: read them from the video.

sessions.title: Guided meditation with Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

guided_practice._demo_mode: ASSUMPTION: in the live demo a session can be finished after this many seconds, so marking the day complete can be shown quickly.

reports._ASSUMPTION: Groups for the teacher's Sadhana report, by practice days in the last 40. From the team's mock-up of 2026-11-15. Confirm with a teacher.

teacher_note._NOTE: The warm note on the teacher's Today tab (features.md E2). wisdom_notes is empty on purpose: the app never writes its own wisdom. The team adds entries as {"text": "...", "source": "..."}.
